title: US Moves Bombers From UK Airbase as Threats Linger
title_cn: US Moves Bombers From UK Airbase as Threats Linger
summary: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Sen. Mark Warner (D-VA), Vice Chairman of the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, says the Senate Intelligence Committee was not briefed about US bombers leaving a UK base and says lawmakers are not receiving regular updates on the conflict with Iran. Heather Conley, senior fellow at AEI, a senior advisor at Evenflow Macro LLC and a former Deputy Assistant Secretary of State in the Bureau of European and Eurasian Affairs, says conflicting explanations from the administration over the movement of US bombers from the UK's Fairford airbase raise questions about the military's ability to protect its assets. Patrick McHenry, Former House Financial Services Chair and Speaker Pro Tempore, says Republicans are playing defense in the 2026 midterms as campaign money moves toward races the party considers more urgent to protect. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: McHenry Says Debt Fight Could Hit Treasuries Harder
title_cn: McHenry Says Debt Fight Could Hit Treasuries Harder
summary: Patrick McHenry, Former House Financial Services Chair, says Republicans are playing defense in the 2026 midterms as campaign money moves toward races the party considers more urgent to protect. McHenry says Republicans should address the debt ceiling while they control Congress and the White House, warning Democrats could use it as leverage next year and that another standoff could cause greater Treasury-market turmoil than the 2023 fight. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Conley: Refined Fuels Remain The Energy Problem

summary: Heather Conley, senior fellow at AEI, a senior advisor at Evenflow Macro LLC and a former Deputy Assistant Secretary of State in the Bureau of European and Eurasian Affairs, says conflicting explanations from the administration over the movement of US bombers from the UK's Fairford airbase raise questions about the military's ability to protect its assets. Conley says improved crude flows through the Strait of Hormuz do not solve the energy problem because supplies of refined products remain constrained. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
